Package neqsim.process.engineering

Class HeatExchangerAutomationWorkflow

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.engineering.HeatExchangerAutomationWorkflow
public final class HeatExchangerAutomationWorkflow extends Object
Automatic actual-instrument, native P&ID/DEXPI and thermal-control-study handoff for a two-circuit gas cooler.

Source equipment and connected material streams remain authoritative. The workflow creates nine actual measurements and one native outlet-temperature PID, acting on an existing utility inlet valve. It never invents pressure-relief protection, fail action, line design or engineering approval. Full dynamic policy stays in the coordinated native model/canonical sidecar; DEXPI retains the typed plant and signal references.

      public static Path export(EngineeringProject project, Dexpi20PlantExportMetadata metadata, Path directory, HeatExchangerControllerTuning.Result tuning) throws IOException
